title: Minecraft 26.3 Snapshot 9

blocks.source_text: Looks like this Snapshot couldn't wait until Tuesday! Arriving a day early, it brings new customization options for Realms. Owners can now increase render distance up to 25 chunks and separately configure render and simulation distance to find the balance that works best for their world.
blocks.translated_text: 看来这个快照迫不及待地想在周二发布了！它提前一天发布，为Realms模式带来了新的自定义选项。现在所有者可以将渲染距离增加到25个区块，并分别配置渲染距离和模拟距离，以找到最适合他们世界的平衡。

blocks.source_text: Aside from these changes, we've also included plenty of technical improvements and bug fixes.
blocks.translated_text: 除了这些变更之外，我们还进行了许多技术改进和错误修复。

blocks.source_text: Happy mining!
blocks.translated_text: 开心采矿吧！

blocks.source_text: New Features
blocks.translated_text: 新功能

blocks.source_text: Realms
blocks.translated_text: Realms模式

blocks.source_text: Added render distance and simulation distance sliders to Realm configuration settings
blocks.translated_text: 在Realms模式配置设置中添加了渲染距离和模拟距离滑块

blocks.source_text: Minor Tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities
blocks.translated_text: 对区块、物品和实体的小幅调整

blocks.source_text: Endermen will now take damage from projectiles if they're riding something
blocks.translated_text: 如果末影人骑着什么东西，它们现在会受到投射物的伤害

blocks.source_text: Endermen and Shulkers no longer teleport onto Bedrock
blocks.translated_text: 末影人和Shulkers不再传送到基岩上

blocks.source_text: UI
blocks.translated_text: 用户界面

blocks.source_text: On macOS, added a "Right Click Emulation" option in Controls settings, which treats Control + left-click as a right-click
blocks.translated_text: 在 macOS 上，控制面板设置中添加了"右键模拟"选项，该选项将 Control + 左键操作视为右键操作

blocks.source_text: Off by default
blocks.translated_text: 默认该选项是关闭的

blocks.source_text: Technical Changes
blocks.translated_text: 技术变更

blocks.source_text: The Data Pack version is now 117.0
blocks.translated_text: 数据包版本现已更新为 117.0

blocks.source_text: Data Pack Version 117.0
blocks.translated_text: 数据包版本：117.0

blocks.source_text: Advancements
blocks.translated_text: 进度条（Advancements）相关功能

blocks.source_text: Validation
blocks.translated_text: 验证（Validation）相关内容

blocks.source_text: Visible root advancements (i.e. ones that have display field, but no parent field) must always declare background field in display structure
blocks.translated_text: 可视化的根进度条（即具有显示字段但没有父级字段的进度条）必须在显示结构中声明背景字段

blocks.source_text: Only root advancements can have background field in display structure
blocks.translated_text: 只有根进度条才能在其显示结构中拥有背景字段

blocks.source_text: Slot Sources
blocks.translated_text: 插槽源（Slot Sources）相关内容

blocks.source_text: Changed minecraft:group
blocks.translated_text: 修改了 minecraft:group

blocks.source_text: Can only use an inline definition in a top-level file
blocks.translated_text: 只能在顶层文件中使用内联定义

blocks.source_text: Loot Functions
blocks.translated_text: 战利品函数

blocks.source_text: Changed minecraft:sequence
blocks.translated_text: 修改了 minecraft:sequence

blocks.source_text: Can only use an inline definition in a top-level file
blocks.translated_text: 只能在顶层文件中使用内联定义

blocks.source_text: Number Providers
blocks.translated_text: 数值提供器

blocks.source_text: Changed minecraft:sum
blocks.translated_text: 修改了 minecraft:sum

blocks.source_text: The summands field was renamed to operands and now accepts an inline value, a single namespaced ID, a list of namespaced IDs, a list of inline values, or a hash-prefixed tag ID of a minecraft:number_provider type
blocks.translated_text: 求和项字段更名为 operands，现在支持内联值、单命名空间的 ID、命名空间 ID 的列表、内联值列表，或以 hash 前缀标记的 minecraft:number_provider 类型的 ID

blocks.source_text: Now requires at least one operand
blocks.translated_text: 现在至少需要一个操作数

blocks.source_text: When used in integer mode, integer mode is used for intermediate steps as well
blocks.translated_text: 在整数模式下使用时，中间步骤也会使用整数模式

blocks.source_text: Added minecraft:product
blocks.translated_text: 新增了 `minecraft:product` 函数

blocks.source_text: Fields:
blocks.translated_text: 字段：

blocks.source_text: operands - A list of numbers as an inline value, a single namespaced ID, a list of namespaced IDs, a list of inline values, or a hash-prefixed tag ID of a minecraft:number_provider type
blocks.translated_text: 操作数：可以是内联数值、带命名空间 的单个 ID、带命名空间的 ID 列表、内联数值列表，或者是带有前缀 `#` 的 `minecraft:number_provider` 类型标签 ID

blocks.source_text: Returns the product of the operands, multiplying them all together
blocks.translated_text: 返回所有操作数的乘积

blocks.source_text: Requires at least one operand
blocks.translated_text: 至少需要一个操作数

blocks.source_text: Added minecraft:minimum
blocks.translated_text: 新增了 `minecraft:minimum` 函数

blocks.source_text: Fields:
blocks.translated_text: 字段：

blocks.source_text: operands - A list of numbers as an inline value, a single namespaced ID, a list of namespaced IDs, a list of inline values, or a hash-prefixed tag ID of a minecraft:number_provider type
blocks.translated_text: 操作数：可以是内联数值、带命名空间 的单个 ID、带命名空间的 ID 列表、内联数值列表，或者是带有前缀 `#` 的 `minecraft:number_provider` 类型标签 ID

blocks.source_text: Returns the minmimum value of the operands
blocks.translated_text: 返回操作数中的最小值

blocks.source_text: Requires at least one operand
blocks.translated_text: 至少需要一个操作数

blocks.source_text: Added minecraft:maximum
blocks.translated_text: 添加了 `minecraft:maximum` 道具

blocks.source_text: Fields:
blocks.translated_text: 字段：

blocks.source_text: operands - A list of numbers as an inline value, a single namespaced ID, a list of namespaced IDs, a list of inline values, or a hash-prefixed tag ID of a minecraft:number_provider type
blocks.translated_text: 操作数：可以是一个数字列表作为内联值、一个命名空间ID、多个命名空间ID的列表、一个内联值列表，或者是一个以哈希前缀开头的 `minecraft:number_provider` 类型的标签ID

blocks.source_text: Returns the minmimum value of the operands
blocks.translated_text: 返回操作数的最小值

blocks.source_text: Requires at least one operand
blocks.translated_text: 至少需要一个操作数

blocks.source_text: Added minecraft:average
blocks.translated_text: 添加了 `minecraft:average` 道具

blocks.source_text: Fields:
blocks.translated_text: 字段：

blocks.source_text: operands - A list of numbers as an inline value, a single namespaced ID, a list of namespaced IDs, a list of inline values, or a hash-prefixed tag ID of a minecraft:number_provider type
blocks.translated_text: 操作数：可以是一个数字列表作为内联值、一个命名空间ID、多个命名空间ID的列表、一个内联值列表，或者是一个以哈希前缀开头的 `minecraft:number-provider` 类型的标签ID

blocks.source_text: Returns the average value of the operands
blocks.translated_text: 返回操作数的平均值

blocks.source_text: Requires at least one operand

content:
Looks like this Snapshot couldn't wait until Tuesday! Arriving a day early, it brings new customization options for Realms. Owners can now increase render distance up to 25 chunks and separately configure render and simulation distance to find the balance that works best for their world.

Aside from these changes, we've also included plenty of technical improvements and bug fixes.

Happy mining!

New Features

Realms

Added render distance and simulation distance sliders to Realm configuration settings

Minor Tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities

Endermen will now take damage from projectiles if they're riding something

Endermen and Shulkers no longer teleport onto Bedrock

UI

On macOS, added a "Right Click Emulation" option in Controls settings, which treats Control + left-click as a right-click

Off by default

Technical Changes

The Data Pack version is now 117.0

Data Pack Version 117.0

Advancements

Validation

Visible root advancements (i.e. ones that have display field, but no parent field) must always declare background field in display structure

Only root advancements can have background field in display structure

Slot Sources

Changed minecraft:group

Can only use an inline definition in a top-level file

Loot Functions

Changed minecraft:sequence

Can only use an inline definition in a top-level file

Number Providers

Changed minecraft:sum

The summands field was renamed to operands and now accepts an inline value, a single namespaced ID, a list of namespaced IDs, a list of inline values, or a hash-prefixed tag ID of a minecraft:number_provider type

Now requires at least one operand

When used in integer mode, integer mode is used for intermediate steps as well

Added minecraft:product

Fields:

operands - A list of numbers as an inline value, a single namespaced ID, a list of namespaced IDs, a list of inline values, or a hash-prefixed tag ID of a minecraft:number_provider type

Returns the product of the operands, multiplying them all together

Requires at least one operand

Added minecraft:minimum

Fields:

operands - A list of numbers as an inline value, a single namespaced ID, a list of namespaced IDs, a list of inline values, or a hash-prefixed tag ID of a minecraft:number_provider type

Returns the minmimum value of the operands

Requires at least one operand

Added minecraft:maximum

Fields:

operands - A list of numbers as an inline value, a single namespaced ID, a list of namespaced IDs, a list of inline values, or a hash-prefixed tag ID of a minecraft:number_provider type

Returns the minmimum value of the operands

Requires at least one operand

Added minecraft:average

Fields:

operands - A list of numbers as an inline value, a single namespaced ID, a list of namespaced IDs, a list of inline values, or a hash-prefixed tag ID of a minecraft:number_provider type

Returns the average value of the operands

Requires at least one operand

Tags

Block Tags

Added #uncarvable - blocks that Carvers can never carve

Added #dangerous_for_teleportation - collection tag defining blocks that are dangerous to teleport on

Added #cat_does_not_teleport_to - blocks that Cats do not teleport to

Added #enderman_does_not_teleport_to - blocks that Endermen do not teleport to

Added #shulker_does_not_teleport_to for blocks that Shulkers do not teleport to

Added #consumable_does_not_teleport_to - blocks that entities do not teleport to when they consume food that teleports randomly when eaten

Empty by default

Item Tags

Added #brewing_potion_inputs - Items that can be placed in a Brewing Stand potion slot, regardless of whether they are brewing recipe inputs

Potion Tags

Added #douses_fire - Potions that douse Fire blocks when they hit something

Added #hurts_water_sensitive_entities - Potions that will hurt entities which are sensitive to water (e.g. Endermen)

Added #extinguishes_entities - Potions that can extinguish entities

Added #rehydrates_axolotls - Potions that will cause Axolotls to rehydrate

看来这个快照迫不及待地想在周二发布了！它提前一天发布，为Realms模式带来了新的自定义选项。现在所有者可以将渲染距离增加到25个区块，并分别配置渲染距离和模拟距离，以找到最适合他们世界的平衡。

除了这些变更之外，我们还进行了许多技术改进和错误修复。

开心采矿吧！

新功能

Realms模式

在Realms模式配置设置中添加了渲染距离和模拟距离滑块

对区块、物品和实体的小幅调整

如果末影人骑着什么东西，它们现在会受到投射物的伤害

末影人和Shulkers不再传送到基岩上

用户界面

在 macOS 上，控制面板设置中添加了"右键模拟"选项，该选项将 Control + 左键操作视为右键操作

默认该选项是关闭的

技术变更

数据包版本现已更新为 117.0

数据包版本：117.0

进度条（Advancements）相关功能

验证（Validation）相关内容

可视化的根进度条（即具有显示字段但没有父级字段的进度条）必须在显示结构中声明背景字段

只有根进度条才能在其显示结构中拥有背景字段

插槽源（Slot Sources）相关内容

修改了 minecraft:group

只能在顶层文件中使用内联定义

战利品函数

修改了 minecraft:sequence

只能在顶层文件中使用内联定义

数值提供器

修改了 minecraft:sum

求和项字段更名为 operands，现在支持内联值、单命名空间的 ID、命名空间 ID 的列表、内联值列表，或以 hash 前缀标记的 minecraft:number_provider 类型的 ID

现在至少需要一个操作数

在整数模式下使用时，中间步骤也会使用整数模式

新增了 `minecraft:product` 函数

字段：

操作数：可以是内联数值、带命名空间 的单个 ID、带命名空间的 ID 列表、内联数值列表，或者是带有前缀 `#` 的 `minecraft:number_provider` 类型标签 ID

返回所有操作数的乘积

至少需要一个操作数

新增了 `minecraft:minimum` 函数

字段：

操作数：可以是内联数值、带命名空间 的单个 ID、带命名空间的 ID 列表、内联数值列表，或者是带有前缀 `#` 的 `minecraft:number_provider` 类型标签 ID

返回操作数中的最小值

至少需要一个操作数

添加了 `minecraft:maximum` 道具

字段：

操作数：可以是一个数字列表作为内联值、一个命名空间ID、多个命名空间ID的列表、一个内联值列表，或者是一个以哈希前缀开头的 `minecraft:number_provider` 类型的标签ID

返回操作数的最小值

至少需要一个操作数

添加了 `minecraft:average` 道具

字段：

操作数：可以是一个数字列表作为内联值、一个命名空间ID、多个命名空间ID的列表、一个内联值列表，或者是一个以哈希前缀开头的 `minecraft:number-provider` 类型的标签ID

返回操作数的平均值

至少需要一个操作数

标签

方块标签

新增了 #不可雕刻 - 被雕刻工具无法雕刻的方块

新增了 #不适合传送 - 用于标记不适合传送的方块的标签

新增了 #猫不会传送到的方块

新增了 #末影人不会传送到的方块

新增了 #石像鬼不会传送到的方块

新增了 #食用后不会传送的方块 - 实体在食用会随机传送的食物时，无法传送到这些方块

默认为空

物品标签

新增了 #brewing_potion_inputs - 可以放入酿造台的药水制作槽中的物品，不论它们是否是酿造配方所需的原料

药水标签

新增了 #douses_fire - 该药水在击中燃烧方块时能够将其扑灭火焰

新增了 #hurts_water_sensitive_entities - 该药水会对对水敏感的实体（例如末影人）造成伤害

新增了 #extinguishes_entities - 该药水可以熄灭火焰或消灭实体

新增了 #rehydrates_axolotls - 该药水能让美西螈恢复水分

修复了26.3版本（Snapshot 9）中的漏洞

[MC-59810](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-59810) - 在macOS系统上冲刺时无法破坏方块

[MC-102836] - 末影人和食用紫颂果实的实体可能会传送到一些危险的地方

[MC-106416] - 爱德曼（Endermen）和其他生物在食用紫颂（Chorus Fruit）后，可能会传送到世界边界之外，并化作粉雪。」

[MC-183446] - 爱德曼在乘坐矿车或船只时仍然会避开投射物。」

[MC-214113] - 爱德曼和修克尔（Shulkers）可以传送到下界的屋顶。」

[MC-227008] - 爱德曼在白天乘坐交通工具时，会不断尝试传送。」

[MC-273708] - 遭受敌方伤害的爱德曼在乘坐其他生物时，会尝试传送。」
